Analysts see Dallas as favorites, but the Giants' pass rush and road atmosphere promise a gritty trench battle in primetime.

data.name: Malik Nabers Questionable for Giants-Cowboys Opener After Knee Injury
data.summary: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers is listed as questionable for the season opener against the Dallas Cowboys at MetLife Stadium, with the call down to game time after he tore his ACL and meniscus last season. The 23-year-old has practiced fully this week and looks sharp, but he insists on protecting his long-term health, saying he'll 'let God tell me' if he's ready. Coach John Harbaugh respects Nabers' input while preparing the team either way, as fans hope to see the dynamic rookie back in action soon.
